build_retinanet_r50_fpn: build a RetinaNet R50 FPN model config for COCO object detection with legacy anchor generator
configure_retina_head: configure RetinaHead with LegacyAnchorGenerator using octave_base_scale 4, 3 scales per octave, and ratios 0.5 1.0 2.0
setup_bbox_coder: setup LegacyDeltaXYWHBBoxCoder for bounding box regression in RetinaNet detection head
configure_smooth_l1_loss: configure SmoothL1Loss with beta 0.11 and loss weight 1.0 for bounding box regression loss
train_retinanet_coco: train RetinaNet R50 FPN on COCO dataset using schedule 1x with default runtime settings
